name: Haouzia Beach
hero_subtitle: Wide sands and dunes, a quieter alternative to the city beach.

overview.title: A large beach north of the city
overview.p1: About fifteen kilometres north, Haouzia Beach offers vast stretches of sand and dunes. It is often quieter than the central beach of El Jadida.
overview.p2: Ideal for a relaxed day: swimming, walking and simple beach cafés. The setting is more open and natural.
overview.p3: Reachable by grand taxi or car. Combine with Sidi Bouzid if you want to explore several beaches.

q1.question: How much time for Haouzia?
q1.answer: 30 to 60 minutes is usually enough for a good visit.

q2.question: Is there an entry fee?
q2.answer: Many outdoor areas are free; the cistern has a ticket. Check on site.

q3.question: Can I visit with children?
q3.answer: Yes, most sites are suitable for families with basic supervision.

q4.question: Is it open every day?
q4.answer: Outdoor sites are generally accessible daily; indoor sites may close one day a week.

q5.question: Do I need a guide?
q5.answer: Not required, but a local guide enriches the history of the Portuguese City.
